annotation.bound_parties_text: The non-binding resolution only calls on or urges the Commission, Member States, car manufacturers and others, and imposes no obligations; it is forwarded to the Council and the Commission.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Instructs its President to forward this resolution to the Council and the Commission.
annotation.dates_quote: European Parliament resolution of 13 March 2018 on a European strategy on Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems (2017/2067(INI))
